entries.name: Swinging Blade
entries.warning: You hear a click, as though something has just been activated.
entries.description: A thin seam in the nearby wall conceals a heavy blade poised to sweep across the room.
entries.revealed_description: A thin seam in the nearby wall conceals a heavy blade poised to sweep across the room.

entries.name: Pitfall
entries.warning: The floor gives a faint creak beneath your weight.
entries.description: A section of flooring is nothing more than a carefully disguised cover over a deep pit.
entries.revealed_description: A section of flooring is nothing more than a carefully disguised cover over a deep pit.

entries.name: Dart Launcher
entries.warning: A soft mechanical tick comes from somewhere nearby.
entries.description: Tiny holes along the wall conceal a series of spring-loaded dart launchers aimed across the passage.
entries.revealed_description: Tiny holes along the wall conceal a series of spring-loaded dart launchers aimed across the passage.

entries.name: Falling Block
entries.warning: Dust suddenly trickles down from the ceiling.
entries.description: A massive stone block overhead has been rigged to drop when the mechanism below is disturbed.
entries.revealed_description: A massive stone block overhead has been rigged to drop when the mechanism below is disturbed.

entries.name: Poison Gas
entries.warning: You hear a quiet hiss that wasn't there a moment ago.
entries.description: Narrow vents hidden in the masonry are beginning to release a strange vapor into the chamber.
entries.revealed_description: Narrow vents hidden in the masonry are beginning to release a strange vapor into the chamber.

entries.name: Swinging Weight
entries.warning: Somewhere above you, a chain suddenly pulls taut.
entries.description: A massive suspended weight is concealed overhead, positioned to swing violently through the room.
entries.revealed_description: A massive suspended weight is concealed overhead, positioned to swing violently through the room.

entries.name: Snare
entries.warning: Something thin brushes against your boot.
entries.description: Nearly invisible cords run across the floor into a concealed mechanism designed to snare anyone crossing them.
entries.revealed_description: Nearly invisible cords run across the floor into a concealed mechanism designed to snare anyone crossing them.

entries.name: Crushing Walls
entries.warning: Stone grinds against stone somewhere behind the walls.
entries.description: Hidden mechanisms connect the opposing walls, allowing them to slowly close together and crush anything between them.
entries.revealed_description: Hidden mechanisms connect the opposing walls, allowing them to slowly close together and crush anything between them.

entries.name: Flame Jet
entries.warning: You smell something sharp and oily in the air.
entries.description: Small nozzles concealed among the stonework connect to a reservoir designed to engulf the passage in flame.
entries.revealed_description: Small nozzles concealed among the stonework connect to a reservoir designed to engulf the passage in flame.

entries.name: Collapsing Ceiling
entries.warning: A small pebble strikes the floor beside you. Then another.
entries.description: Several ceiling supports have been deliberately weakened and connected to a concealed trigger.
entries.revealed_description: Several ceiling supports have been deliberately weakened and connected to a concealed trigger.

entries.name: Needle Lock
entries.warning: The mechanism gives an unusually sharp click as it moves.
entries.description: A tiny needle is concealed inside the lock or handle, positioned to strike the hand of anyone manipulating it.
entries.revealed_description: A tiny needle is concealed inside the lock or handle, positioned to strike the hand of anyone manipulating it.

entries.name: False Door
entries.warning: The door shifts strangely when touched, almost as though the entire frame moved.
entries.description: The apparent doorway is part of a larger mechanism designed to drop, tilt, or collapse when opened.
entries.revealed_description: The apparent doorway is part of a larger mechanism designed to drop, tilt, or collapse when opened.

entries.name: Flooding Chamber
entries.warning: You hear the distant rush of moving water.
entries.description: Hidden channels and sealed sluices surround the chamber, designed to rapidly fill the area with water.
entries.revealed_description: Hidden channels and sealed sluices surround the chamber, designed to rapidly fill the area with water.

entries.name: Rolling Boulder
entries.warning: A deep *thunk* echoes from somewhere beyond the passage.
entries.description: A large stone has been secured farther up the passage and connected to a trigger that releases it downhill.
entries.revealed_description: A large stone has been secured farther up the passage and connected to a trigger that releases it downhill.

entries.name: Net Trap
entries.warning: Something overhead rustles despite the still air.
entries.description: A weighted net has been carefully concealed above the area, ready to drop and entangle anyone beneath it.
entries.revealed_description: A weighted net has been carefully concealed above the area, ready to drop and entangle anyone beneath it.

entries.name: Spiked Floor
entries.warning: One of the floor stones sinks slightly beneath your foot.
entries.description: Several floor panels conceal rows of spikes connected to pressure mechanisms beneath the stone.
entries.revealed_description: Several floor panels conceal rows of spikes connected to pressure mechanisms beneath the stone.

entries.name: Magical Ward
entries.warning: For an instant, faint markings shimmer across a nearby surface and disappear.
entries.description: An arcane sigil has been worked into the area, its lines forming a dormant magical ward awaiting a trigger.
entries.revealed_description: An arcane sigil has been worked into the area, its lines forming a dormant magical ward awaiting a trigger.

entries.name: Alarm
entries.warning: You hear a faint metallic chime somewhere in the distance.
entries.description: A concealed line or pressure mechanism connects this area to an alarm elsewhere in the dungeon.
entries.revealed_description: A concealed line or pressure mechanism connects this area to an alarm elsewhere in the dungeon.

entries.name: Sealing Doors
entries.warning: Something heavy shifts inside the walls behind you.
entries.description: Counterweights and hidden tracks are positioned to slam nearby doors shut and seal the chamber.
entries.revealed_description: Counterweights and hidden tracks are positioned to slam nearby doors shut and seal the chamber.

entries.name: Pendulum
entries.warning: A slow metallic scrape comes from somewhere overhead.
entries.description: A large pendulum mechanism is concealed above, positioned to sweep repeatedly across the chamber once released.
entries.revealed_description: A large pendulum mechanism is concealed above, positioned to sweep repeatedly across the chamber once released.
